接下来的日子，王建新又恢复了该干嘛干嘛的节奏。

只不过现在每天都要去巡一次边，不像以前那样隔三差五才去一趟。万一对方再派人来呢？上次抓了六个，谁知道会不会再来六个？再来几个也不怕，但得防着点，不能让人打了措手不及。

每天上午，他骑着马，带着大毛它们五个，怀里揣着小狐狸，沿着铁丝网走一圈。对面安安静静的，连个人影都没有。那些脚印已经被风吹没了，一切跟什么都没发生过一样。

巡完边回来，做饭、吃饭。现在做饭的花样越来越多了，今天红烧肉，明天清炖牛肉，后天手把肉，换着花样吃。主食也换着来，米饭、面条、烙饼、饺子，想吃啥做啥。调料齐全，食材新鲜，做出来的饭菜香得很。

下午，他把明面上的那七只羊赶出来，在土坯房附近的草场上放放。七只羊不多，不用怎么赶，它们自己就在草地上吃草。大毛它们五个在草地上疯跑，追蝴蝶撵蚂蚱，闹得鸡飞狗跳。小狐狸趴在草地上，眯着眼睛晒太阳，偶尔追追蚂蚱，追两步就不追了，懒得很。

王建新从空间里把地毯拿出来，铺在草坪上，往上面一躺，晒着太阳。四月的草原，太阳暖洋洋的，不冷不热，风吹过来，带着青草的味道和羊粪蛋子的味道。他眯着眼睛，看着天上的云，一朵一朵的，慢悠悠地飘过去。

“这才是人过的日子。”王建新伸了个懒腰，把帽子扣在脸上，迷迷糊糊地打了个盹。

天黑后，他进了空间，开始修炼。现在晚上基本上不咋睡觉了，得抓紧修炼，早日突破炼气四层。盘腿坐在河边，灵气在体内运转，一圈又一圈，丹田里的灵气雾越来越浓，离突破越来越近了。那几条鱼他舍不得再吃了，留着繁殖，等多了再吃。

时间过得很快，一个星期就这么过去了。

这天下午，王建新正在草地上放羊，躺在毯子上晒太阳，大毛它们五个趴在旁边打盹。远远地，他听见了汽车的声音。

他坐起来，往远处看。一辆绿色的吉普车从土路上颠过来，扬起一路尘土。

王建新赶忙站起来，拍了拍身上的土，把地毯收进空间——这玩意儿不能让外人看见，解释不清。他把大毛它们五个和小狐狸也收进空间，只留下七只羊和一匹马在草地上吃草。

然后他整了整衣服，往前走了几步，迎接来车。

吉普车在土坯房门口停了。车门打开，下来两个人。一个是民兵连的连长李斌，穿着一身旧军装，腰里别着手枪，脸晒得黑红黑红的。另一个是个穿中山装的中年人，戴着眼镜，文质彬彬的，手里提着一个公文包。

王建新认识李斌，之前培训的时候见过，没怎么说话。那个中年人没见过，看打扮像是公社里的干部。

“王建新同志！”李斌大步走过来，脸上带着笑。

王建新立正敬礼。巡边员都是被编入民兵里的，知青也好牧民也好，都归民兵连管。见了连长，得敬礼。

李斌回了个礼，然后转过身，指着那个中年人说：“这是公社的刘干事。”

In the days that followed, Wang Jianxin resumed his routine of doing whatever he was supposed to do.

It's just that now I have to patrol the border every day, instead of only going there every three or five like before.What if the other party sends someone again?We caught six last time, who knows if there will be another six?Don’t be afraid of a few more coming, but you have to be on guard so that no one is caught off guard.

Every morning, he rode a horse, took five of them, and a little fox in his arms, and walked along the barbed wire fence.It was quiet on the other side, not even a soul in sight.Those footprints have been blown away by the wind, and everything is as if nothing happened.

Come back from patrol, cook and eat.Nowadays, there are more and more ways to cook. One day, braised pork, the next day, beef stew, and the day after tomorrow, you can eat the meat in different ways.The staple food is also changed, rice, noodles, pancakes, dumplings, whatever you want to eat.The seasonings are complete, the ingredients are fresh, and the meals are delicious.

In the afternoon, he drove out the seven sheep on the outside and let them pasture near the adobe house.Seven sheep are not many, so they don’t need to be driven much. They just graze on the grass by themselves.Big Mao and the other five ran wildly on the grass, chasing butterflies and chasing grasshoppers, making a great deal of noise.The little fox lay on the grass, squinting his eyes to bask in the sun, and occasionally chased the grasshopper, but stopped chasing it after two steps. He was very lazy.

Wang Jianxin took out the carpet from the space, spread it on the lawn, lay down on it, and basked in the sun.On the grassland in April, the sun is warm, neither cold nor hot, and the wind blows over, carrying the smell of green grass and sheep dung and eggs.He squinted his eyes and watched the clouds in the sky float slowly past one by one.

"This is how people live." Wang Jianxin stretched out, put the hat on his face, and took a nap.

After dark, he entered the space and began to practice.Now I basically can't sleep at night. I have to practice hard and break through the fourth level of Qi refining as soon as possible.Sitting cross-legged by the river, the spiritual energy circulates in the body. Circle after circle, the spiritual energy mist in the Dantian becomes thicker and thicker, and the breakthrough is getting closer and closer.He couldn't bear to eat those few fish anymore, so he kept them for breeding and would eat them when there were more.

Time flies so fast, a week has passed like this.

That afternoon, Wang Jianxin was grazing sheep on the grass and lying on the blanket to bask in the sun. Da Mao and the other five lay next to them and took a nap.In the distance, he heard the sound of a car.

He sat up and looked into the distance.A green jeep came over the dirt road, kicking up dust all the way.

Wang Jianxin stood up quickly, patted the dirt on his body, and put the carpet into the space - this thing cannot be seen by outsiders, and it is difficult to explain.He put the five big cats and the little fox into the space, leaving only seven sheep and one horse grazing on the grass.

Then he straightened his clothes and walked a few steps forward to greet the oncoming car.

The jeep stopped in front of the adobe house.The car door opened and two people got out.One is Li Bin, the commander of the militia company. He is wearing an old military uniform, with a pistol in his waist, and his face is tanned and red.The other was a middle-aged man in a Chinese tunic suit, wearing glasses, and was elegant, holding a briefcase in his hand.

Wang Jianxin knew Li Bin. They met him during training before, but they didn't talk much.I had never seen that middle-aged man before, but he looked like a cadre in the commune.

"Comrade Wang Jianxin!" Li Bin strode over with a smile on his face.

Wang Jianxin stood at attention and saluted.The line patrolmen were all incorporated into the militia, and all the educated youths and herdsmen were under the control of the militia company.When you see the company commander, you have to salute.

Li Bin returned the salute, then turned around, pointed at the middle-aged man and said, "This is Director Liu from the commune."
